data.description:

data.title: Abbisko Presents Preclinical Findings for Selective CDK4 Inhibitor
data.description:
Abbisko Cayman Limited ( (HK:2256) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Abbisko Therapeutics presented at 2026 ENA a study selected for the Late-Breaking Abstracts program, detailing preclinical findings for ABSK192 in HR+/HER2- breast cancer models. The compound showed potent CDK4 inhibition with more than 70-fold selectivity over CDK6, antiproliferative activity regardless of PIK3CA mutation status, G1 arrest and robust single-agent antitumor activity in vivo.

Combination experiments found synergistic activity with endocrine, PI3K and CDK2 inhibitors in vitro; combinations with fulvestrant, imlunestrant or GDC-0077 produced enhanced antitumor efficacy and tumor-volume regression in vivo. Abbisko said the findings support ABSK192’s development potential as a selective CDK4 inhibitor and provide a preclinical rationale for single-agent and combination regimens.

data.title: HUTCHMED Presents Preclinical HMPL-A830 Data at Cancer Research Conference
data.description:
An update from HUTCHMED (China) ( (HK:0013) ) is now available.

HUTCHMED develops oncology drug candidates, including antibody-targeted therapy conjugates (ATTCs) that pair monoclonal antibodies with small-molecule inhibitor payloads for solid tumors. Its ATTC approach combines targeted therapies with dual mechanisms of action.

The release reports preclinical HMPL-A830 data presented at the EORTC-NCI-AACR conference in Barcelona on November 18–20, 2026. The EGFR-directed ATTC showed activity across diverse KRAS alterations in laboratory and mouse studies, while a global Phase I trial is evaluating the candidate; a GSK subsidiary received rights outside Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan under a September 2026 agreement.

data.title: HBM Holdings Announces NMPA Acceptance of LET003 IND Application
data.description:
HBM Holdings Ltd. ( (HK:2142) ) has issued an announcement.

HBM Holdings develops monoclonal antibody drug candidates, including LET003 for overweight or obesity, using its Hu-mAtrIx™ AI platform.

China’s NMPA accepted the IND application for LET003, the company’s first AI-enabled drug candidate and a dual ACVR2A/ACVR2B blocker. In preclinical studies, LET003 showed superior pharmacokinetic characteristics versus multiple competitor molecules and, when combined with semaglutide, enhanced fat reduction while preserving lean mass.

data.description:

data.title: SSY Group Receives China Approvals for Dialysis Solutions and Arginine Injection
data.description:
SSY Group ( (HK:2005) ) has shared an update.

SSY Group Limited has a strategic focus on renal replacement therapy, with products including peritoneal dialysis solution, hemofiltration replacement fluid and other related offerings. It is also continuing to develop an emergency and critical care treatment pipeline that includes therapeutic infusions.

The group received approvals from China’s National Medical Products Administration for four 2,000ml bicarbonate-buffered peritoneal dialysis solutions, covering standard and low-calcium formulas with glucose concentrations of 1.5%, 2.5% and 4.25%. The products are mainly used for peritoneal dialysis in patients with chronic renal failure, including cases involving inadequately improved hypermagnesemia.

The company said the approvals establish a broader peritoneal dialysis portfolio across lactate and bicarbonate formulations and enhance its renal replacement therapy competitiveness. It also received approval for a 200ml:20g arginine hydrochloride injection, a large-volume infusion for emergency treatment of acute hyperammonemia that does not require clinical dilution.

data.title: Sa Sa Reports 239.1% Rise in Group Profit; Hong Kong and Macao Same-Store Sales Up 38.9%
data.description:
Sa Sa International Holdings Limited ( (HK:0178) ) has issued an announcement.

Sa Sa International Holdings Limited is a retailer with stores and B2C online sales, focused on Hong Kong and Macao. In unaudited results for the six months ended 30 September 2026, turnover rose 30.3% year on year to HK$2,593.1 million, gross profit increased 31.1% to HK$989.5 million and gross profit margin rose 0.3 percentage points to 38.2%.

In Hong Kong and Macao, same-store sales increased 38.9% year on year, tourist sales mix rose to 63.6%, and the Group recorded a net increase of eight Hong Kong stores through 15 November 2026. data.title: Lenovo Reports Higher First-Half Revenue and Adjusted Profit
data.description:
An announcement from Lenovo Group ( (HK:0992) ) is now available.

Lenovo reported unaudited first-half fiscal 2026/27 revenue of US$57.2 billion, up 46% year on year, while adjusted profit attributable to equity holders rose 170% to US$2.4 billion and adjusted net margin reached 4.3%. Second-quarter revenue reached a record US$30.2 billion, up 48%, while AI-related revenue increased 79% and represented 36% of total revenue.

The Infrastructure Solutions Group’s second-quarter revenue rose 178% to US$11.3 billion, with operating profit reaching US$1.1 billion, while the Intelligent Devices Group’s revenue grew 15% to US$17.4 billion. The Solutions and Services Group increased revenue 20% to US$3.1 billion, and operating profit rose 40% to US$801 million.

On an HKFRS basis, Lenovo recorded a first-half loss attributable to equity holders of US$1.248 billion, mainly due to a US$3.596 billion non-cash fair-value loss on warrants. Operating cash flow reached US$1.6 billion and free cash flow US$1.2 billion in the second quarter, while the Board declared an interim dividend of HK9.0 cents per share.

data.title: CSRC Approves Registration of Orient Securities’ Proposed Shanghai Securities Acquisition
data.description:
Orient Securities Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:3958) ) has provided an update.

Orient Securities Co., Ltd. received China Securities Regulatory Commission approval to register its proposed acquisition of 100% of Shanghai Securities. The transaction involves issuing specified consideration A shares to Bailian Group, Guotai Haitong, SIG Investment, SIG and Shanghai Chengtou Group, alongside a cash payment, and approves Orient Securities becoming the actual controller of Xinjiang Qianhai Alliance Asset Management and Hicend Futures.

The approval authorizes Bailian Group and SIG and entities under its control to become major shareholders of Orient Securities following the share exchange. It also requires risk segregation, controls on related-party transactions and conflicts of interest, orderly integration, client and employee protections, amended constitutional documents, and timely completion of required issuance and disclosure procedures.
